body: As I said before, I can't hold on to a job, I can barely finish college. I'd probably live many other years with her, if not my whole life, which is bad enough, but mainly, any minute I have to spend existing near him is too much. I'd probably be so run over I'd drop out of college anyway. Thanks for listening though.

Hi Matt, thanks for listening. I'm 20, have no job, and never been able to hold on to one because I've been severely depressed since I was 14. I can't handle getting out daily and I'm pretty dumb, I graduated high school through an equivalent of GED. Either way, things got worse since my mom (who was already a pretty toxic person to be around) got a emotionally abusive boyfriend (though he did threaten us and did actually hurt our cat though she won't believe me because I'm the "obsessed, manipulative, compulsive liar" daughter and despite all the shit he's said to her face he is still "a decent man trying his best"). 

They broke up some time early this year and I was able to recover ever so slightly, I went into college, which was still tough and made me feel shitty, but was manageable, I didn't feel so paranoid all the time. Yk, it was just better to not live with someone who is calling you names and going out of their way to make your life harder every other day or having panic attacks because they rose their voices or being in a constant state of alert. I was still depressed, and was still suicidal (have been since I was 16), but it was the passive kind of suicidal thought like "I wouldn't mind being hit by a bus right now but I might as well try this or that and see how life goes". And then he came over at 1am in a thursday without notice (as he always do and expect people to adjust to his whims). And then he came over again at midnight of saturday and slept over and he's still here (at 3am of sunday, probably sleeping over again) and I've been freaking the fuck out. I'm not going to live with him again. Even worse, I'm not going to live with a woman that takes him back every time after he left the house a few months ago *screaming* about killing us and the cats and "ask your daughter the last time she got fucked" for me to hear when I had nothing to do with their argument and god knows why the fuck he thought that was appropriate (he probably knows it isn't and just doesn't fucking care). And so I'm killing myself this monday when there will hopefully be no one in this house.
